name: Hegzaflon Global pvt ltd
india_angle: The company is based in India and positions itself as a leading manufacturer and exporter of PTFE lined products.
summary: Hegzaflon Global Pvt Ltd, operating under the brand Hi-Tech Applicator, specializes in manufacturing PTFE lined valves and tube fittings, primarily serving the chemical processing industry. Their products include a range of polymer linings and heat exchangers, which may have peripheral applications in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
